specs.name: CPU
specs.value: Rockchip RK3576J, Quad-core Cortex-A72 (1.6GHz) + Quad-core Cortex-A53 (1.4GHz)

specs.name: GPU
specs.value: ARM Mali G52 MC3, supports OpenGL ES 1.1, 2.0 and 3.2, OpenCL 2.1, Vulkan 1.2, up to 4K 60fps video encoding, up to 4K 120fps video decoding

specs.name: Storage
specs.value: TF Card, Supports up to 128GB SDHC

specs.name: USB
specs.value: 1 x USB 2.0 HOST, 1 x USB 3.0 HOST, 1 x USB Type-C (USB 3.0 port and USB-C port cannot be used at the same time)

specs.name: RTC
specs.value: High accuracy RTC with farad capacitor, can work 1 week after power off (default). High accuracy RTC with lithium coin battery, can work 3 years after power off (optional).

specs.name: RS232
specs.value: Default to 2 x RS232 (including 1 debug port). Up to 4 x RS232 by swapping 2 x RS485 to RS232.

specs.name: RS485
specs.value: Default to 2 x RS485. Optionally, these 2 x RS485 can be configured to RS232. Optionally, 1 x RS485 can be configured to CAN(CAN0)

specs.name: CAN
specs.value: Default to 1 x CAN FD. Optionally, 1 x RS485 can be configured to CAN(CAN0), providing up to 2 x CAN FD.

specs.name: OS
specs.value: Android 14, Debian12, Buildroot Linux Qt 5.15, Ubuntu 22.04
